business_summary: Needs Well Inc. engages in the IT service business in Japan. It provides information security solution such as Virtualization Solutions, Remote PC Array, Resalio lynx, Okta, ESET PROTECT solution, VOTIRO, Symantec Web Isolation, and MobiControl services. The company also provides finance solutions including CXone, Robotic Call, and WELCOME services. In addition, it provides AI solutions consisting of Work AI Service, DX Suite, Es Prophetter, Vi Prophetter, Qc Prophetter, Ad Prophetter, As Prophetter; AI chatbot solutions consists of Chat Document, FSGen, and PRGen. Further, it offers development tool such as WebPerformer, and WebPerformer-NX. Additionally, the company provides SmartWMS, IT re-engineering services, WinActor, Power Platform implementation support services, SAP Concur, Corpo Card, N Navi, UI/UX Navigator, DXPAIT, DgentPaper, SharePoint utilization services, ManaSupport, BP-Collabo, Smartphone rental service, Zero or Ichi Wi-Fi, and 11MGN. Further, it also offers IoT and AI solution such as BearAI. In addition, the company offers finance, telecommunication carrier, social infrastructure, distribution, migration development, logistics, industry, web, artificial intelligent, digital transformation, robotic process automation, IT infrastructure, software testing, and IT outsourcing and support services, as well as construction and construction machinery services. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.
business_summary_ko: 니즈웰(Needs Well Inc.)은 일본에서 IT 서비스 사업을 영위하고 있습니다. Virtualization Solutions, Remote PC Array, Resalio lynx, Okta, ESET PROTECT 솔루션, VOTIRO, Symantec Web Isolation, MobiControl 서비스 등의 정보 보안 솔루션을 제공합니다. CXone, Robotic Call, WELCOME 서비스 등 금융 솔루션도 제공하고 있습니다. 또한 Work AI Service, DX Suite, Es Prophetter, Vi Prophetter, Qc Prophetter, Ad Prophetter, As Prophetter로 구성된 AI 솔루션을 제공합니다. AI 챗봇 솔루션은 Chat Document, FSGen, PRGen으로 구성됩니다. 또한 WebPerformer, WebPerformer-NX 등의 개발 도구도 제공합니다. 또한 SmartWMS, IT 리엔지니어링 서비스, WinActor, Power Platform 구현 지원 서비스, SAP Concur, Corpo Card, N Navi, UI/UX Navigator, DXPAIT, DgentPaper, SharePoint 활용 서비스, ManaSupport, BP-Collabo, 스마트폰 렌탈 서비스, Zero 또는 Ichi Wi-Fi 및 11MGN을 제공합니다. 또한 BearAI와 같은 IoT 및 AI 솔루션도 제공합니다. 또한 금융, 통신 사업자, 사회 인프라, 유통, 이주 개발, 물류, 산업, 웹, 인공 지능을 제공합니다.
